name: Helical Torque Hub
core_rationale: Central bronze worm-drive engineer town of Helical-Gear Trench at [1, 1] where torque-wrights balance Krono's drive-shaft clutches above the Worm-Drive Gearbox.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Filtered amber oil-cooling basins around the central worm-clutch rotunda

North.lock_message: Unclutched bevel-pinion teeth spin at gale-force speeds across the northern Bevel-Pinion Overlook; Torque-Master Helix requires the Bronze Worm-Clutch Key before engaging the safety brake.

resident_npcs.name: Torque-Master Helix
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Welcome to Helical Torque Hub! Check the pressure gauges at my 0.60 meter bronze console before descending into the gearbox.

resident_npcs.name: Clutch-Smith Vera
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Down in the Worm-Drive Gearbox, an overdrive construct swallowed the Bronze Worm-Clutch Key needed to brake the northern Bevel-Pinion Overlook!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Helical-Gear Trench at [1, 1] directly above Krono's Worm-Drive Gearbox.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Bronze worm-clutch rotunda surrounded by spinning helical drive shafts and amber cooling basins.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: 0.58 to 0.60m bronze consoles, 0.14m cog-risers, 2.20m x 1.65m doorways, and 13.0m plazas for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Safe town hub (0 resident_spawns) at [1, 1] with symmetric West, Dungeon, and North (fog_of_lore) portals.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Guards the northern Bevel-Pinion Overlook behind a Fog of Lore portal with explicit lock_message.
